descriptionNullable:
Welcome to the Comprehensive Usage Log Dataset of the popular Over-The-Top (OTT) Platform [Netflix](https://www.netflix.com/). This dataset is a valuable resource for researchers, data scientists, and enthusiasts interested in understanding user behaviour within a popular online streaming service. This meticulously curated dataset offers a rich and diverse collection of user interactions, providing insights into user preferences, devices the platform has been accessed from, search history, and video consumption patterns on the OTT platform.

The dataset provided has been processed to remove of all possible personal information. The code helps you remove all possible personal information and create a new dataset with same structure. You can get the actual data from your Netflix account by raising a request from their website. To fetch your data
1. Login to the website
2. Select the profile of the account holder
3. Click on their icon in the top-right corner of the screen and choose Account
4. Under settings, click on Download your personal information.
5. Press the button to Submit Request
6. Netflix will email the main account holder when the file is ready to download.

This web page [Netflix personal information](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100624) has the steps to request your user data from Netflix.

Dataset Highlights:

- **User Profiles**: Gain a deeper understanding of OTT users by exploring their demographic information, subscription type, and engagement levels. Analyze how different user segments interact with the platform.
- **Device Information**: Study the devices used to access the OTT service, including smartphones, tablets, smart TVs, and more. Uncover trends in device preference and platform optimization for different devices.
- **Video Search History**: Delve into the search behavior of users to uncover popular search queries, trending topics, and user preferences. Discover how search queries evolve over time and the content users are most interested in.
- **Search Result Interactions**: Explore how users interact with search results. Understand which search results receive the most clicks, which are ignored, and how search result interaction influences video selection.
- **Video Viewing Patterns**: Analyse user video viewing behaviour, including session duration, preferred genres, most-watched videos, and viewing frequency. Gain insights into binge-watching habits and content consumption preferences.

Potential Use Cases:

- Personalized Recommendations: Leverage the dataset to develop advanced recommendation algorithms that provide users with tailored content suggestions based on their viewing history, search behavior, and user profile.
- User Experience Enhancement: Identify pain points and areas of improvement in the user experience. Optimize the platform for different devices and user segments to ensure seamless navigation and content discovery.
- Content Strategy Optimization: Use the dataset to determine the popularity of certain genres, actors, directors, and more. Make informed decisions about content acquisition and creation to meet user demand.
- Market Analysis: Gain competitive insights by comparing user engagement, search behavior, and viewing patterns with other OTT platforms. Understand market trends and make data-driven strategic decisions.
